pr.title: Let the person say they don't understand an inbox item
pr.head: 307cdc5bd5ea327760fc9e8ff2dd597fde46aeb1

summary: Projector's inbox holds items that agents post for you: a question to answer, a notice to read, and a request for work only you can do. Projector's panel, above the Claude Code prompt, lists them, and each item's drawer shows its detail and the actions you can take on it. An agent writes an item from inside its own work, so an item can be clear to the agent and opaque to you. Until now the only way to say so was discuss, which costs a typed sentence, and for a notice it led nowhere: a notice could not be revised, and a reply about a subagent's notice never reached that subagent.

This pull request adds I don't understand on 6 in every open item's drawer. One press runs project inbox unclear, which records an unclear field on the item. The panel's deliverer then sends UNCLEAR <number> <subject> to the agent that posted the item, and the agent revises the item in place, which clears the mark. Notices become revisable with revise --notice. To keep 6 free in every drawer, a question takes at most four options besides its recommendation, and a request at most four options.

It carries out the inbox/unclear plan and marks it completed. This head also merges main, which brought in #381's rename of the request drawer's decline request to dismiss request on 8; the merge keeps both changes.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Line: a message the inbox owes an item's agent, such as ANSWER, RESTORED, STARTED, or now UNCLEAR.
  • Claim: a deliverer's hold on the line it is sending, so two deliverers never send it twice. delivered or reopen settles it.
  • Open line: a line an item owes while it stays open. STARTED was the only one; UNCLEAR joins it in OPEN_LINES.
  • Stale-text guard: the press passes the text the drawer showed, and the CLI refuses it with exit code 65 when the agent revised the item since.

groups.title: The store and the CLI
groups.kicker: The new unclear field, the line it owes, and the commands that record, deliver, and clear it
intro: The inbox store keeps each item as a JSON file. An item now has an optional unclear field, { at }, plus deliveredAt once UNCLEAR reaches the agent. While that field is undelivered, the item owes its agent the unclear line.

The change treats unclear exactly like a request's started, the one other line an item owes while it stays open. Both are now named in OPEN_LINES, so claim, settle, and clear_for_outcome handle them with one rule. A claimed open line keeps its claim when an answer or dismissal lands, because it may already wait in the session's queue. An unclaimed one is dropped, since you no longer need the explanation.

revise now takes a notice, with --notice for its subject, and every revision clears unclear. MAX_OPTIONS drops from five to four. answer now clears through clear_for_outcome like the other outcomes, so a claimed UNCLEAR reaches the agent before the answer.

groups.title: Permissions and agent instructions
groups.kicker: unclear asks before an agent runs it, and agents learn what UNCLEAR asks of them
intro: unclear records something only you may say, so it joins answer, dismiss, snooze, done, decline, and start among the commands Projector's permission rules make an agent ask before running. Without the rule, an agent allowed Bash(project *) could mark its own item unclear. Codex's rules leave it to Codex's usual approval. The rule reaches your settings once you run project init again.
The agents block that project init writes into AGENTS.md moves to version 23 and tells agents to revise an item when UNCLEAR arrives.

groups.title: The panel and the tools
groups.kicker: The drawer's new action, the unclear mark, delivery of any kind of item, and the tool schemas
intro: Projector's panel is a Claude Code plugin under hooks/. Each open item's drawer now lists I don't understand this <kind> on 6, above discuss on 7, dismiss on 8, and snooze on 9. The press passes the subject and detail the drawer shows, and a refusal for stale text leaves the drawer open on a fresh read of the store.

The deliverer used to skip notices, because a notice owed nothing. It now delivers a notice's UNCLEAR, to the subagent that posted the item while it runs, or else to the main loop with a note naming the subagent. An item stored before the cap can hold a choice on 6, and its drawer draws the action without a digit.
The ask, request, and revise tools cap options at four, and revise takes a notice field.
